<thought>Using the most intense peak at m/z 235.1395 as the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈16 % M+1 intensity, consistent with ~14 carbons) is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (exact neutral mass 234.1256 Da, [M+H]⁺ 235.1329 Da). This best fits the data, so the molecular formula is C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
